Yes, Scott Derrickson and Ed Wood were of the same nationality. Both men were American. 

Scott Derrickson, born on July 16, 1966, is an American director, screenwriter, and producer best known for helming horror films like *Sinister*, *The Exorcism of Emily Rose*, and *Deliver Us from Evil*, as well as the 2016 Marvel Cinematic Universe installment *Doctor Strange* [1]. Similarly, Edward Davis Wood Jr. (October 10, 1924 – December 10, 1978) was an American filmmaker, actor, writer, producer, and director whose cult status and career served as the central focus of the 1994 biographical comedy-drama film *Ed Wood* [2].

The woman who portrayed Corliss Archer in the 1945 film *Kiss and Tell* is **Shirley Temple** (later known as Shirley Temple Black). 

After her highly successful tenure as a child actress, she transitioned into public service and held several prominent diplomatic and government roles within the United States federal government. Specifically, she served as the **Chief of Protocol of the United States**. She was also commissioned as a **United States Ambassador**, where she managed bilateral affairs in **Ghana** and **Czechoslovakia** [[5]].
